meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'even', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Do not even dare to say that.
Even a child knows.
Even Mum doesn't know.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'меть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'dare', paired with 'посметь'.

meanings.en: to close, shut down (of a venue)
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'крываться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to lock oneself in'.

examples.trans: Do not dare lock yourselves in from me!
Our bar is closing.
It is already morning. Our bar is closing.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'you', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: What is with you, mommy, huh?

examples.text: Он ведёт себя как ревнивый парень.
examples.trans: He behaves like a jealous boyfriend.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everyone', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Today we have a draw.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'волить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will fire', paired with 'увольнять'.

examples.trans: You're fired!
He was fired.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'умать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to think (it over)', paired with 'думать'.

examples.trans: Sorry, I thought the wrong thing.
I'll think about it.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
